meaning: the robot has a floor drive: its physical model and its figures with and without a carrier

schema.title: floor_drive
schema.description: the robot has a floor drive: its physical model and its figures with and without a carrier
schema.$comment: Foundry application vocabulary for the incumbent dessim robot aspects. Open to fields a newer writer adds. Numbers name their units; they are robot figures, not positions in a frame.

kind.description: constant executes at constant_speed_mm_s; trapezoidal uses max_speed_mm_s with acceleration and deceleration. HTM spatial searches use max_speed_mm_s in either mode. These are catalog data, never run settings. Optional when storing historical or incomplete catalog statements; Studio run readiness requires an explicit model for each deployed floor-driving class.

constant_speed_mm_s.description: HTM constant-mode execution speed, independent of the kinematic maximum used for spatial searches. Required by the HTM reader; not used by a floor-driving VTM.

loaded.description: Motion figures in one load state. A floor-driving HTM states constant_speed_mm_s and quarter_turn_secs; absent reversal_secs means two quarter turns.

constant_speed_mm_s.description: HTM constant-mode execution speed, independent of the kinematic maximum used for spatial searches. Required by the HTM reader; not used by a floor-driving VTM.
